title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Posted date Sep. 07, 2026
Contract type Full time
Job ID R\-259589
  
**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------


Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life\-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.


The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly\-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.


**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------


Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.


Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting\-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.


**Success Profile**
-------------------


Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth\-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.


### **Tech innovators**


Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.


### **Ownership takers**


If you're a self\-aware self\-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.


### **Challenge seekers**


Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.


### **Proactive collaborators**


Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-259589 **Date posted** 09/07/2026
**GCL: D2Introduction to role:**


Are you ready to build cloud\-native products that accelerate antibody discovery and help bring medicines to patients faster! Join us to turn advanced data and AI into real\-world impact by designing end\-to\-end solutions scientists love to use.


You will be part of a global, high\-calibre team of software, data, and MLOps engineers, architects, product leaders, and scientists building an Augmented Biologics Discovery Platform. You will shape the experience and the architecture, turning complex scientific workflows into intuitive, production\-grade software that shortens the path from idea to clinical candidate.


Working side by side with product, design and scientific users, you will create scalable services, data products and applications in the cloud. How would you design a cohesive, delightful experience that researchers choose every day because it makes their work faster, clearer and more insightful?


**Accountabilities:**


* Full\-Stack Solution Design: Own the design and implementation of scalable, cloud\-native applications that meet scientists’ requirements end to end.
* AI/ML Data Products: Deliver production\-grade data products that enable and accelerate AI/ML use cases in discovery.
* Product and UX Innovation: Build novel features that solve long\-standing drug discovery problems with experiences that feel seamless and unified.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, design, data science, and scientific teams to build cutting\-edge services and user journeys.
* Architecture and Data Models: Propose and implement changes to data models, core architecture, and the codebase to improve quality and velocity.
* Full\-Stack Delivery: Contribute across all layers of the stack, even where you are less experienced, to move the product forward.
* Agile Ways of Working: Advance modern, agile software practices and help foster a vibrant engineering culture.
* Platform Reliability: Plan, implement and support core infrastructure to improve scalability, reliability, performance, and availability.
* Engineering Excellence: Champion rigorous practices including code reviews, automated testing, logging, monitoring, and alerting.
* Learning and Mentorship: Stay on top of tech trends, experiment, engage with internal and external communities, and mentor peers.

description:

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------


Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life\-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.


The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly\-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.


**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------


Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.


Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting\-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.


**Success Profile**
-------------------


Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth\-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.


### **Tech innovators**


Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.


### **Ownership takers**


If you're a self\-aware self\-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.


### **Challenge seekers**


Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.


### **Proactive collaborators**


Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-259592 **Date posted** 09/08/2026
**Job Title: Engineer \- Fullstack**


**GCL:C2**


**Introduction to role:**


Are you ready to build resilient, cloud\-native Java services and intuitive React applications that speed the delivery of life\-changing medicines to patients? This role sits at the heart of our digital products, where strong engineering meets real\-world impact for colleagues across research, manufacturing, and commercial operations.


In this team you will deliver features end to end with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React (TypeScript), and SQL, collaborating closely with architects and platform engineers who are advancing our cloud and AI capabilities. Do you want to see your code power decisions at scale and transform how our colleagues work every day?


You will start by owning well\-scoped stories and quickly grow into developing reviews, performance tuning, and automation that improve quality and speed across multiple applications.


**Accountabilities:**


* Full\-stack Delivery: Develop, validate, and ship features across Java/Spring Boot services and React (TypeScript) UIs that streamline critical workflows and unlock clear efficiency improvements.
* Invent, develop, and improve REST APIs. Apply strong relational database skills (Oracle, PostgreSQL, and SQL) to maintain reliable data, performance, and secure integrations for internal consumers.
* Architecture Alignment: Participate in technical design reviews; translate enterprise architecture, security, and regulatory standards into practical, maintainable solutions.
* Quality and Testing: Build and maintain robust test plans; apply unit and component testing tools (including frameworks like Jest) to protect quality and enable continuous integration.
* Cloud\-native Engineering: Containerize and deploy with Docker and Kubernetes; define infrastructure with Terraform and YAML to achieve repeatable, scalable environments.
* Agile Collaboration: Work within a distributed Scrum team, partnering with engineers, architects, project managers, platform teams, vendors, and customers to deliver increments that matter.
* Operations and Deployment: Complete deployments to application servers; solve issues; improve reliability through monitoring, automation, and well\-documented runbooks.
* Continuous Improvement and Automation: Identify and validate automation opportunities across build, test, and operations; evaluate new tools and methods that improve efficiency and developer experience.
* AI and Data Enablement: Experiment with modern AI services and LLM techniques, such as vector\-based similarity, to unlock smarter features where appropriate.
* Growth and Impact: Start by delivering high\-quality code and documentation; progress to crafting guidelines and influencing multiple applications and services.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**


* 4\+ years of Overall IT experience
* Should have practical experience in Java/JS coding, Advanced JAVA concepts, Spring Boot, REACT, J2EE, Webservices, Oracle, Postgres, SQL
* Over 3 years working with ReactJs using Typescripts
* Over 5 years involved in developing REST API’s
* Over 3 years of experience working with RDBMS and solid hands\-on skills in SQL queries
* Actively involved in any of the UI frameworks such as Jest etc.
* Good exposure to AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, YAML
* Should have worked in distributed agile model and continuous integration
* Carrying out deployment into application servers
* Analytical skills with attention to detail in quality
* Demonstrate ability to apply technical knowledge to multiple systems and support multiple business groups and applications
* Good communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to work with global teams to achieve objectives, collaborative
* Ability to create, maintain and implement test plans
* Ability to organize and prioritize work, meets deadlines, and work independently
* Essential: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, information technology \& information systems, or comparable specialization with 2\+ years of relevant experience; Experience with software development languages and patterns/ testing phases, types, and techniques; Experience in scrum teams, agile software development techniques and methodologies, and programming languages, as applicable to own area; Experience with cloud platforms, data analytics, and SQL knowledge as applicable to own area; Experience with relevant technologies/ systems/ concepts as applicable within area (e.g., deployment of platforms like Docker, SaaS; web \& mobile application design, software testing \& maintenance).

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**


* Knowledge in python is added advantage
* 3\+ years of experience on python with exposure to flask
* Good to have experience in working with Azure Open AI, LLM exposure in areas such as vectors, similarity search using extract, similarity/confidence score etc.
* Good to have Exposure to AWS Sage Maker
* Desirable: Prior experience in an information services/ information technology environment with understanding of service delivery KPIs (e.g., SLA; MTR); Experience working within a quality and compliance environment and application of policies, procedures, and guidelines.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.


Why AstraZeneca:


Here, engineering fuels science. You will work with modern stacks and cloud platforms, exploring data, analytics, AI, and machine learning to create products that our colleagues rely on every day to reach patients faster. We combine serious investment and executive backing with a culture that values ownership, experimentation, and learning—think hackathons, open collaboration with experts across disciplines, and real opportunities to shape technical direction. Your craft will grow alongside your impact, and we value kindness alongside ambition as we build the future of digital healthcare together.


Call to Action:


Take the next step today to build products that reach patients worldwide and accelerate your growth!
